-- OJO: la decision de publicar vive ahora en el repositorio, en
-- lib/coste-importacion.js, y se lanza con scripts/recalcula-publicacion.cjs.
--
-- Este nodo se mantiene solo para que, si vuelve a correr, escriba lo mismo que
-- el catalogo. Habia dos formulas diciendo cosas distintas y la que mandaba era
-- la que nadie miraba: el catalogo estuvo semanas publicado con los numeros de
-- un modelo que ya no existia. Lo suyo es desactivarlo.
--
-- El modelo: PopCar NO compra el coche. Lo vende el concesionario aleman al
-- cliente espanol, y nosotros cobramos un fee de 3000 EUR por el
-- servicio: revisarlo alli, traerlo, homologarlo, matricularlo y entregarlo.
-- El impuesto de matriculacion lo paga el cliente aparte, y la garantia es
-- opcional y de un tercero.
WITH de AS (
  SELECT id, brand, model, year, mileage, title, fuel, power_cv, co2, displacement, body_type, price::numeric de_price
  FROM moveadvisor_market_offers
  WHERE country='DE' AND price IS NOT NULL AND price>0 AND year IS NOT NULL AND mileage IS NOT NULL
),
comp AS (
  SELECT de.id, de.de_price, c.comps, c.es_median,
    -- Lo que se le suma al precio del anuncio: nuestro fee y el impuesto.
    (3000 + (CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric > 0 THEN CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 120 THEN 0 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 159 THEN 0.0475 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 199 THEN 0.0975 ELSE 0.1475 END WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ '(el[eé]ctric|enchufa|plug)' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' THEN 85 + 0.33*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) ELSE 95 + 0.42*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) END) * (CASE WHEN COALESCE(de.title,'') ~* '(\y4x4\y|\yawd\y|4matic|quattro|xdrive|allrad|4motion)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' AND COALESCE(de.body_type,'') ~* '(suv|todo ?terreno|pick ?up|4x4|monovolumen|furgon)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN NOT (lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo') AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) / (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric / 1000) < 80 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'h[ií]brid' THEN 0.75 ELSE 1 END)) <= 159 THEN 0.0475 WHEN ((CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' THEN 85 + 0.33*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) ELSE 95 + 0.42*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) END) * (CASE WHEN COALESCE(de.title,'') ~* '(\y4x4\y|\yawd\y|4matic|quattro|xdrive|allrad|4motion)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' AND COALESCE(de.body_type,'') ~* '(suv|todo ?terreno|pick ?up|4x4|monovolumen|furgon)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN NOT (lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo') AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) / (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric / 1000) < 80 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'h[ií]brid' THEN 0.75 ELSE 1 END)) <= 199 THEN 0.0975 ELSE 0.1475 END END)*0.6*COALESCE(c.es_median,0)) AS cost,
    -- Lo que se ahorra el cliente frente a comprar el mismo coche aqui.
    (c.es_median - de.de_price - 3000 - (CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric > 0 THEN CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 120 THEN 0 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 159 THEN 0.0475 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.co2,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric <= 199 THEN 0.0975 ELSE 0.1475 END WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ '(el[eé]ctric|enchufa|plug)' THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' THEN 85 + 0.33*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) ELSE 95 + 0.42*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) END) * (CASE WHEN COALESCE(de.title,'') ~* '(\y4x4\y|\yawd\y|4matic|quattro|xdrive|allrad|4motion)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' AND COALESCE(de.body_type,'') ~* '(suv|todo ?terreno|pick ?up|4x4|monovolumen|furgon)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN NOT (lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo') AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) / (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric / 1000) < 80 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'h[ií]brid' THEN 0.75 ELSE 1 END)) <= 159 THEN 0.0475 WHEN ((CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' THEN 85 + 0.33*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) ELSE 95 + 0.42*COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) END) * (CASE WHEN COALESCE(de.title,'') ~* '(\y4x4\y|\yawd\y|4matic|quattro|xdrive|allrad|4motion)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo' AND COALESCE(de.body_type,'') ~* '(suv|todo ?terreno|pick ?up|4x4|monovolumen|furgon)' THEN 1.12 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN NOT (lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'di[eé]sel|gas[oó]leo') AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(de.power_cv,0) / (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(de.displacement,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric / 1000) < 80 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END) * (CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(de.fuel,'')) ~ 'h[ií]brid' THEN 0.75 ELSE 1 END)) <= 199 THEN 0.0975 ELSE 0.1475 END END)*0.6*COALESCE(c.es_median,0)) AS margin
  FROM de
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*)::int comps, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY es.price::numeric) es_median
    FROM moveadvisor_market_offers es
    WHERE COALESCE(es.country,'ES')='ES' AND es.price IS NOT NULL AND es.price>0
      AND lower(es.brand)=lower(de.brand) AND lower(es.model)=lower(de.model)
      AND es.year BETWEEN de.year-1 AND de.year+1
      AND es.mileage BETWEEN de.mileage*0.7 AND de.mileage*1.3
  ) c
)
UPDATE moveadvisor_market_offers m SET
  market_price_es   = round(comp.es_median),
  import_comps      = comp.comps,
  import_cost       = round(comp.cost),
  import_margin     = round(comp.margin),
  import_margin_pct = round((comp.margin / NULLIF(comp.es_median,0))::numeric, 3),
  import_score      = CASE WHEN comp.comps>=15 AND comp.margin>0 THEN round(comp.margin) ELSE 0 END,
  -- Se publica si: sigue viva, el coche llega al minimo para que el fee tenga
  -- sentido, hay comparables suficientes y al cliente le queda un ahorro real.
  import_published  = CASE WHEN m.import_locked THEN m.import_published
                      ELSE (COALESCE(m.is_active, TRUE)
                            AND comp.de_price >= 12000
                            AND comp.comps>=15
                            AND comp.margin/NULLIF(comp.es_median,0) >= 0.15
                            AND comp.margin/NULLIF(comp.es_median,0) <= 0.5) END,
  import_scored_at  = NOW()
FROM comp WHERE m.id = comp.id;
